For every $$$i$$$ that respects $$$l \le i \le r$$$, change $$$a_i$$$ to the opposite. That is, $$$a_i := 1 - a_i$$$;
For every $$$i$$$ that respects either $$$1 \le i \lt l$$$ or $$$r \lt i \le n$$$, change $$$b_i$$$ to the opposite. That is, $$$b_i := 1 - b_i$$$.
